page.content:
Co-creator of Spider-Man and Doctor Strange.

How Steve Ditko connects

  • Character: Spider-Man — Steve Ditko co-created Spider-Man.
  • Character: Doctor Strange — Steve Ditko co-created Doctor Strange.

What is Steve Ditko?

Steve Ditko co-created Spider-Man and Doctor Strange with Stan Lee, defining their early looks, supporting casts, and mystical tone.

Key threads lead to Spider-Man and Doctor Strange.
